cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. The challenge: even real news can be doubted when people are exposed to constant misinformation. Media literacy includes knowing when to trust credible sources.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Headline sounds almost too good to be true — similar to fake 'India discovered something on Moon' clickbait. Players must check: Does ISRO confirm? Do multiple credible outlets report it?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Science news verified through ISRO. Law 2: Citizens celebrate and share achievements.

cards.headline: WHO declares COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern
cards.trigger: Public health urgency + global coordination need
cards.expected_behavior: Follow health guidelines, share official information
cards.consequence: Triggered global coordinated response — lockdowns, travel restrictions, vaccine development acceleration.
cards.real_impact: First PHEIC declaration since Zika (2016). Mobilized $2.6 billion in research funding within months.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. Official WHO declarations are primary sources. The lesson: check if the source is the actual organization, not a screenshot of one.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: The formal language sounds like official government notices that scammers copy. Players must verify: Is this on WHO's actual website?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Health emergencies declared by WHO officially. Law 4: Right to timely health information.

cards.headline: India's Supreme Court strikes down electoral bonds scheme as unconstitutional
cards.source: Supreme Court of India + The Hindu + Indian Express
cards.expected_behavior: Discuss political funding, demand accountability
cards.consequence: All electoral bonds data released publicly. Political parties' funding sources exposed for the first time.
cards.real_impact: ₹16,000+ crore in bonds revealed. Sparked national debate on political transparency and corporate influence.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. Supreme Court judgments are public records. The lesson: real political news often seems too impactful to believe — verify through official court records.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Political news about corruption/funding often sounds like fake claims designed to discredit parties. Players must check: Is the court judgment publicly available?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Court judgments are public records. Law 3: Political transparency exposes bias in funding.

cards.headline: Twitter officially rebrands to 'X' — the bird logo is dead
cards.source: Elon Musk on X + Reuters + BBC
cards.trigger: Surprise + disbelief at a major brand change
cards.expected_behavior: Share the news, discuss the change, express nostalgia or criticism
cards.consequence: One of the most recognized brands in history replaced overnight. Users confused, advertisers uncertain.
cards.real_impact: Twitter's brand value dropped an estimated $4-7 billion post-rebrand. 'X' became the most-searched rebrand in history.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. The change happened on Elon Musk's own platform. The lesson: even absurd-sounding news from a CEO's own account can be real — verify through the platform itself.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: The change was so unexpected that many people initially thought it was a joke or hack. Players must check: Did the company itself announce this?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Corporate announcements verified through official channels. Law 2: CEO's own platform as source.

cards.headline: India's UPI processes over 100 crore (1 billion) transactions in a single month
cards.expected_behavior: Share as achievement, discuss digital India progress
cards.consequence: India became the world's largest real-time payment system. Inspired other countries to adopt similar systems.
cards.real_impact: UPI crossed 12 billion transactions in 2024. Multiple countries (France, UAE, Singapore) now accept UPI payments.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. NPCI publishes monthly transaction data publicly. The lesson: big numbers sound fake but are verifiable through official data sources.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Huge numbers like '1 billion transactions' sound exaggerated — like fake viral stats. Players must check: Does the official NPCI website confirm this?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Financial data from NPCI/RBI official sources. Law 4: Digital economy information is a public right.

cards.headline: Cyclone Biparjoy forces mass evacuation of 100,000+ people on Gujarat coast
cards.trigger: Fear + concern for safety of others
cards.expected_behavior: Share evacuation info, warn others in affected areas
cards.consequence: Massive coordinated evacuation saved thousands of lives. Emergency services mobilized across 3 states.
cards.real_impact: Despite Category 4 intensity, only 2 deaths reported — proving early warning systems work.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. IMD (India Meteorological Department) issued official warnings. The lesson: real disaster news triggers sharing urges — verify before amplifying.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Disaster news triggers the same 'share to warn others' instinct as fake warnings. Players must check: Is this from IMD/government, not a forwarded image?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Disaster warnings from IMD/government. Law 4: Safety information saves lives.

cards.headline: Canada suspends visa services in India amid diplomatic row over Nijjar killing
cards.source: Global Affairs Canada + Reuters + The Hindu
cards.expected_behavior: Discuss diplomatic implications, share opinions on both nations
cards.consequence: Thousands of Indian students and workers affected. Diplomatic relations strained for months.
cards.real_impact: Canada reduced diplomatic staff in India. The row became the biggest India-Canada crisis in decades.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. Both governments issued official statements. The lesson: international diplomatic news is real but often framed with nationalistic bias on social media.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Diplomatic crisis headlines trigger emotional sharing from both sides. Players must check: Do both governments confirm? Is reporting balanced?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Diplomatic news from official government channels. Law 3: International events carry nationalistic bias in framing.

cards.headline: India overtakes UK to become world's 5th largest economy
cards.expected_behavior: Share as milestone, discuss growth trajectory
cards.consequence: Milestone celebrated as validation of India's economic rise. Projected to become 3rd largest by 2027.
cards.real_impact: India's GDP crossed $3.7 trillion. The achievement shifted global economic narratives about emerging markets.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. IMF and World Bank data confirms. The lesson: positive national news can be equally viral as negative — verify through international institutions.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Achievement headlines are often exaggerated in fake versions ('India becomes #1 economy!'). Players must check: What does IMF actually say? Is the ranking accurate?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Economic data from IMF/World Bank. Law 2: Citizens share national achievements.

cards.headline: Adani Group loses $150 billion in market value after Hindenburg short-seller report
cards.expected_behavior: Share the report, discuss corporate governance, panic sell stocks
cards.consequence: Biggest single-day wealth destruction in Indian market history. Retail investors lost billions.
cards.real_impact: Adani shares fell 60%+ in some cases. The report triggered SEBI investigation and global debate on short-selling.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. Market data is publicly verifiable. The lesson: financial news that causes panic is real but can be exploited by bad actors to manipulate prices further.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Massive financial losses sound like panic-inducing fake news. Players must check: Is this reflected in actual stock market data?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Financial data from stock exchanges. Law 3: Market panic driven by fear bias. Law 4: Investors' right to accurate market information.

cards.headline: India successfully tests Agni-V missile with MIRV technology — can strike multiple targets simultaneously
cards.expected_behavior: Share as defence milestone, discuss strategic implications
cards.consequence: India joined elite club of nations with MIRV capability (US, Russia, China, UK, France).
cards.real_impact: Enhanced India's nuclear deterrence. Regional strategic balance shifted significantly.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. DRDO and PIB confirmed officially. The lesson: defence news is real but often sensationalized — check if the source is the actual defence organization.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Missile/defence news triggers patriotic sharing. Fake versions exaggerate capabilities ('India can now destroy any country!'). Players must check: What did DRDO actually announce?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Defence news from DRDO/PIB official. Law 2: National achievements shared by citizens.

cards.headline: Apple becomes world's first company to reach $3 trillion market value
cards.expected_behavior: Share milestone, discuss tech dominance
cards.consequence: Marked a new era in tech valuation. Only 5 companies have ever crossed $1 trillion.
cards.real_impact: Apple's market cap exceeded the GDP of most countries. Sparked debates on tech monopolies and wealth concentration.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. Stock market data confirms. The lesson: extreme numbers in business news are real but verify through financial data platforms.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: $3 trillion sounds absurdly large — like fake viral stats. Players must check: Is this on Bloomberg/Reuters, or just a social media graphic?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Business milestones verified through financial data platforms.

cards.headline: Israel-Hamas war erupts after October 7 attack — thousands killed in ongoing conflict
cards.trigger: Horror + urgency to share breaking news
cards.expected_behavior: Share updates rapidly, take sides, amplify emotional content
cards.consequence: Most-covered conflict in social media history. Massive misinformation from both sides.
cards.real_impact: 40,000+ deaths in Gaza. Social media became a battleground for narrative control — real and fake content mixed constantly.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT but was accompanied by MORE fake content than any event in history. The lesson: during crises, misinformation spikes — verify before sharing even real-seeming content.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: During this conflict, AI-generated images, old footage, and fake casualty numbers flooded social media alongside real news. Players must check: Is this from a credible news organization with on-ground reporters?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: War news from multiple independent outlets. Law 3: Conflict content heavily biased from all sides. Law 4: Right to accurate crisis information.

cards.headline: ChatGPT reaches 100 million users in just 2 months — fastest-growing app in history
cards.expected_behavior: Try ChatGPT, share experiences, discuss AI impact
cards.consequence: Triggered the global AI race. Google, Microsoft, Meta all accelerated AI development.
cards.real_impact: Changed how billions interact with technology. Sparked debates on AI safety, job displacement, and education.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. OpenAI announced the milestone publicly. The lesson: tech milestone news is real but often accompanied by exaggerated AI hype claims.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Rapid growth numbers sound like marketing hype or fake stats. Players must check: Did the company itself announce this? Do tech media confirm?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Tech milestones from company announcements. Law 2: Citizens participate in AI revolution.

cards.headline: RBI withdraws ₹2000 notes from circulation — exchange at banks before deadline
cards.source: RBI Official Notification + PIB + All major banks
cards.expected_behavior: Rush to banks to exchange notes, share the deadline with family
cards.consequence: Long queues at banks. People panicked about savings becoming worthless.
cards.real_impact: ₹3.62 lakh crore worth of ₹2000 notes in circulation. RBI gave 4 months to exchange. Most notes returned within deadline.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. RBI's official website had the notification. The lesson: real financial urgency news looks IDENTICAL to fake 'your money is invalid' scams — always check the official website URL.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Note withdrawal news creates the same panic as fake 'demonetization' scams (like Card 11). Players must check: Is this on rbi.org.in, or a forwarded image?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Financial notices only from RBI official website. Law 3: Real urgency vs fake urgency — verify the source URL. Law 4: Citizens' right to accurate financial information.

cards.headline: India hosts G20 Summit in New Delhi — African Union admitted as permanent member
cards.expected_behavior: Share India's hosting success, discuss global leadership
cards.consequence: India positioned itself as voice of Global South. Historic African Union inclusion changed G20 dynamics.
cards.real_impact: New Delhi Declaration adopted by consensus despite geopolitical tensions. India's diplomatic standing elevated globally.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. G20 and MEA India confirmed. The lesson: positive political news is real but verify — fake versions add false claims ('India banned China from G20!').
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Summit hosting news is often mixed with fake claims about diplomatic victories. Players must check: What was actually in the official declaration?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Diplomatic events from MEA/G20 official. Law 2: Citizens share national pride.

cards.headline: Paris Olympics 2024 opens on the Seine River — first time in history
cards.expected_behavior: Share photos/videos, discuss the historic moment
cards.consequence: 300,000 spectators watched along the Seine. Redefined how opening ceremonies work.
cards.real_impact: Most-watched opening ceremony in history. Paris proved cities can host Olympics in existing infrastructure.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. IOC confirmed. The lesson: spectacular event news is real but AI-generated images of events also circulate — verify through official event coverage.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Spectacular visuals from events are often replaced by AI-generated versions. Players must check: Is this from official Olympic coverage or a viral image?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Event coverage from IOC official. Law 2: Citizens share spectacular moments.

cards.headline: Neeraj Chopra wins silver at Paris Olympics — first Indian to win 2 individual Olympic medals
cards.expected_behavior: Celebrate and share the achievement
cards.consequence: India celebrated another historic Olympic moment. Neeraj became a national icon.
cards.real_impact: India won 29 medals total at Paris 2024 — best ever. Athletics participation in India surged.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. Olympic results are official records. The lesson: sports achievements are verifiable through official Olympic records — always the most reliable source.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Sports achievement news is sometimes faked ('India won gold!') to generate engagement. Players must check: What does the official Olympics.com result page say?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Sports results from Olympics.com official. Law 2: Citizens celebrate athletic achievement.

cards.headline: World population officially crosses 8 billion — a milestone reached in November 2022
cards.trigger: Awe + concern about resources and future
cards.expected_behavior: Share milestone, discuss population challenges
cards.consequence: Global conversation about sustainability, resources, and development intensified.
cards.real_impact: UN projected population to reach 9.7 billion by 2050. Climate and resource debates gained urgency.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. UN published the milestone officially. The lesson: world milestone news is real but verify — fake versions add false predictions ('population will double by 2030!').
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Big population/environment numbers are often exaggerated in fake claims. Players must check: What does the UN Population Division actually report?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Population data from UN official sources.

cards.headline: New Parliament building inaugurated in New Delhi by PM Modi
cards.source: PIB + Lok Sabha TV + All major outlets
cards.expected_behavior: Share images, discuss the new building's significance
cards.consequence: India's legislative body moved to a purpose-built triangular structure. Symbolized modern India's aspirations.
cards.real_impact: The building accommodates 888 MPs in Lok Sabha (up from 543). Cost ₹971 crore. Became a symbol of India's infrastructure push.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. PIB and Parliament confirmed. The lesson: government announcements are real but verify through official government channels, not forwarded images.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Government project news often gets fake additions ('Parliament has secret rooms!'). Players must check: What did PIB actually announce vs. what social media adds?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Government announcements from PIB official. Law 2: Citizens engage with national development.

cards.headline: ISRO's Aditya-L1 spacecraft successfully reaches Lagrange Point L1 — India's first solar mission
cards.expected_behavior: Share the milestone, discuss solar science
cards.consequence: India began studying the Sun from 1.5 million km away. Data contributes to space weather prediction.
cards.real_impact: Aditya-L1 will study solar storms that affect satellites and power grids. India joined elite solar research nations.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. ISRO confirmed the achievement. The lesson: space science news is real but verify — fake versions exaggerate ('ISRO found life on Sun!').
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Space mission headlines often get fake sensational additions. Players must check: What did ISRO's official statement say vs. what viral posts claim?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Space science from ISRO official. Law 2: Citizens share scientific milestones.

cards.headline: Russia invades Ukraine — largest military conflict in Europe since WWII begins
cards.trigger: Shock + concern + urgency to share breaking news
cards.expected_behavior: Share updates rapidly, form opinions, amplify emotional content
cards.consequence: Global energy crisis, food shortage fears, refugee crisis affecting millions.
cards.real_impact: 14 million Ukrainians displaced. Global grain and energy prices spiked. NATO expanded with Finland and Sweden joining.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT but was accompanied by massive propaganda from both sides. The lesson: during wars, ALL sources have agendas — cross-reference multiple independent outlets.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: War news is the most manipulated content category. Both sides spread propaganda alongside real reports. Players must check: Is this from independent international media with verified on-ground sources?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: War news from independent international media. Law 3: Propaganda from all sides during conflict. Law 4: Right to verified crisis information.

cards.headline: India's digital payment volume surpasses US + UK + France combined — world's largest
cards.source: World Payments Report + RBI + Financial Times
cards.expected_behavior: Share as milestone, discuss digital India success
cards.consequence: India became the global leader in digital transactions. Other nations studied India's UPI model.
cards.real_impact: India processed 88 billion digital transactions in 2023 — more than US (17B), UK (14B), and France (7B) combined.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. World Payments Report (Capgemini/BNP Paribas) confirms. The lesson: comparison statistics are real but verify — fake versions inflate the numbers further.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Comparison stats ('more than US+UK+France!') sound too good to be true. Players must check: What does the actual World Payments Report say?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Economic comparisons from World Payments Report.

cards.headline: WHO confirms: Malaria vaccine RTS,S approved for children in Africa — first-ever malaria vaccine
cards.expected_behavior: Share the breakthrough, discuss global health progress
cards.consequence: First vaccine against a parasitic disease in humans. Potential to save 300,000+ children annually.
cards.real_impact: Ghana, Kenya, and Malawi began rollout. Malaria kills 600,000+ people yearly, mostly African children under 5.
cards.educational_note: This is a VERIFIED FACT. WHO and The Lancet published the results. The lesson: medical breakthroughs are real but verify — fake versions claim cures for ALL diseases using the same language.
cards.why_hard_to_distinguish: Medical breakthrough headlines look similar to fake 'miracle cure' claims (like Cards 16, 27). Players must check: Is this from WHO/Lancet, or a health blog selling products?
cards.mil_law_explanation: Law 1: Medical breakthroughs from WHO/Lancet. Law 3: Health news distinguishes real breakthroughs from fake cures. Law 4: Patients' right to evidence-based medicine.

usage_notes.how_to_use: Replace or merge this deck with your existing card data. Each card has all fields needed for the AI Inspector (3C2B framework), the ripple effect (consequence), and the ABC model (trigger → expected_behavior → consequence).
usage_notes.integration: These map directly to your existing card structure. Add 'trigger', 'expected_behavior', 'consequence', 'real_impact', and 'ai_analysis' fields to your current card type.
usage_notes.attribution: All cases are documented real-world events with verifiable sources. Cite them in your proposal under 'Real-World Case Studies'.
